messages:
Mia (Docs): Hey team — opened PR to update the Nebula3b model card and model-catalog entry. Main changes: explicit supported-hardware table, clarified long-context behavior (up to 32k with streaming), corrected quantization compatibility notes, and replaced an outdated SDK snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4892 Please skim and flag anything customer-facing.

Arjun (Eng): quick Q — will this require a runtime-compat mapping update? e.g. q8_0 vs q4_k_m naming differences can confuse ops.

Mia (Docs): good point. I left labels as they are but added a note pointing to the runtime mapping doc. If eng-runtime wants a rename we need to coordinate. @Arjun any suggestions on phrasing?

Leo (ML): ran microbenchmarks on the new quant profile yesterday. numbers added to the PR comments: ~85 tok/s on T4 (batch=1, seq=8k) and ~220 tok/s on A10. We should present ranges and include the test config — I can paste the bench command in the PR.

Kevin (DevEx): I also fixed the python snippet; it used the old sync API and mismatched args. New snippet uses streaming:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
for chunk in client.generate('Summarize long document', model='nebula3b-quant', stream=True):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```
Can someone sanity-check JS parity?

Sophia (PM): We need the catalog page updated too (supported models table + a short rollback/canary note). Also request QA for the customer-facing phrasing — avoid words like "fastest" without qualifiers. @Mia can you add a short latency expectation blurb?

docbot: docs-ci/pr-check failed — markdown-lint: duplicate anchors in limits table. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/1234

Mia (Docs): On it — fixing anchors and adding Sophia's suggested paragraph. Re-requesting review after push.

Arjun (Eng): FYI runtime has a fallback path: nebula3b-quant -> nebula3b-fp16 when some kernels are missing. Please add that compatibility fallback in the card so customers understand graceful degradation.

Leo (ML): +1 on fallback note. Also suggested wording for throughput: "expected throughput: 80–120 tok/s on T4 (batch=1); 200–260 tok/s on A10; measured with seq=8k and canonical prompt used in our benchmark suite." Put exact run config in the PR.

Kevin (DevEx): JS parity snippet looks like:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient();
for await (const chunk of client.generateStream({ model: 'nebula3b-quant', prompt: 'Summarize long document' })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```
I'll push this small example to the PR in ~30m.

docbot: docs-ci/pr-check passed on second run :thumbsup:

Mia (Docs): Thanks all. If no objections I'll merge in ~10m and follow up with a short post in #docs-release about the catalog update and the benchmark caveats. :rocket:
